metadata.description: Confident AI agent skills for AI tracing, eval setup, and the Confident AI API. For Cursor.

plugins.name: confident-trace
plugins.description: Skills for instrumenting AI applications with the confident-trace SDK, exporting raw OpenTelemetry traces to Confident AI, and migrating from Langfuse.

plugins.name: confident-client
plugins.description: Skills for managing Confident AI organizations, projects, members, roles, governance policies, and API keys with the confident-ai SDK.

plugins.name: confident-eval-setup
